blockers: performance SLO confirmation for streaming API
notes:
Summary: DiffWatcher builds an AI-assisted PR review product embedded in IDEs and GitHub — automated diff summarization, suggested review comments, and candidate ranking for reviewers. Team: CTO + 3 eng leads, product owner is ex-GitHub engineer. Primary customers are mid-size platform teams. Interested in model pinning, deterministic outputs for CI, and streaming low-latency suggestions inside VSCode and JetBrains IDEs.

Key quotes: "We need suggestions to appear in the editor in <100ms for single-line in-context completions; PR-level diff summaries can be async but should return in <2s for a 200-line diff."

Notes from kickoff call (11/07): integrations: VSCode extension + GitHub checks + GitHub Actions. Want ability to pin to specific model hash and rollback. Strong preference for reranking endpoint (generate N candidate comments, then rerank by relevance/TD metrics).

Engineering constraints: must preserve exact diff context and file hashes; prefer KV-preserved cache keys for identical patch sets. Determinism required for CI gating — need stable seed + model-version pinning. Also want automatic fallback to smaller quantized model when dedicated pool saturated.

Commercial: evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency during peak merge windows, but open to hosted API for initial POC. Cost sensitivity: currently targeting $0.03-0.10 per PR review on average.

Security: SSO/SAML + audit logs required, retention controls (30/90/365 day tiers), and KMS integration for workspace keys. Legal asked for DPA + assurance on residency for EU/UK customers down the line.

Sales notes: AE to push POC template, ask for sample repo and two weeks of PR history. SE to scope streaming benchmarks and provide preload/caching recommendations.
